routes.task: Download someone's video from a link
Cut a video into scenes (clip + first/mid/last stills + scenes.json)
Probe a clip (duration, fps, size, sample rate, channels)
Check video length = audio length
Check clips are safe to concat (same sample rate and channels)
Join clips with hard cuts
Join clips with dissolves (audio kept whole)
Edit from a plan (cuts, motion, shots, transitions)
Insert/overlay/split a shot into a master
Narration (TTS) from a script
One quick line with explicit voice settings and seed
Replace the voice in a clip's dialogue
...with per-character settings/seed, only the spoken spans

routes.use: `node tools/vidkit/js/eleven.mjs stt`; from an alignment json: `vidkit words`

routes.task: Music that follows the topic, tone and beat arc
Sound effects: generate
Sound effects: mix into the cut
routes.use: `mix_sfx.py`; move cues out from under narration: `vidkit.speech.snap_to_gaps`

routes.task: Clips of one kelompok differ in colour / grade
routes.use: `python3 -m tools.vidkit colormatch CLIPS...` (report; add `--apply OUTDIR` only after the owner looked at `vidkit sheet`; `vidkit.colormatch.plan/apply`)

routes.task: Beat times of a music file
Land SFX cues on the music beat
routes.use: `python3 tools/sfx_snap.py <project> --music-plan work/music-plan.json` (or `--music FILE`; exit 2 bad input, 3 no beats; writes `work/sfx-plan.snapped.json`; `snap` = `vidkit.beats.snap`)

routes.task: Skip an expensive step when its inputs did not change
routes.use: `vidkit.stages.fingerprint(files, params, version)` + `StageCache(path).is_fresh/record`. `tools/edit_render.py` already uses it: a re-run skips unchanged segments (`--no-cache` forces a full render)

Karaoke subtitles from a word list + centre watermark (any opacity)
Thumbnail on the first frames + as mp4 cover (subtitles stay off it)
routes.use: `python3 -m tools.vidkit cover video thumb out [--ass f.ass]`

routes.task: Logo on a white box -> mark that blends onto a prop
routes.use: `python3 -m tools.vidkit unwhite logo.png out.png`, then CSS `mix-blend-mode: multiply`
